mapper.select: SELECT permission_id FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_id

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0
